summary: Complete Production Implementation Specification for Category Legal Cabinet, Notary Study & Accounting Firm in Algeria (Atrium OS). Features exhaustive feature-by-feature specifications covering the CPCA Procedural Deadline Engine, Notary Deed Register & Décret 08-243 Tariff Calculator, Double-Lock Fiduciary & Escrow Vault, SCF 7-Class General Ledger, Article 317 Fiscal Stamp Duty Cashier, and Bilingual Arabic/French Matter CRM. Includes complete role-based UI separation across 4 distinct operational personas, 9 categories of edge cases and failure modes, TypeScript quadruple traceability data models, pure utility test lists, cross-feature conflict analysis, a 10-point self-review, and a phased vertical slice build order.
